prompt_text: Donor CRM with flat rate pricing no per user fees
response_text:
**LiveImpact offers the nonprofit CRM with flat-rate pricing and no per-user fees that best matches your query.**

### Key Details from Search Results
- **Flat-Rate Model**: LiveImpact uses a single monthly or annual fee, regardless of the number of users (staff, board, volunteers) or contact records stored. This avoids per-user charges and database-size tiers, making it budget-predictable for growing organizations. No incentives to delete donor data to cut costs.
  - Source: [1] LiveImpact blog – Explicitly describes their "flat-rate, modular pricing" with "no per-user fees, no contact record tiers," and case management included (not an add-on).

### Comparison to Other Options
Most nonprofit CRMs use per-user, per-contact, or tiered pricing, which don't fully match:
| CRM | Pricing Model | Matches Query? | Notes |
|-----|---------------|----------------|-------|
| **LiveImpact** | Flat-rate (one fee) | ✅ Yes | Unlimited users/records; modular add-ons. |
| Bloomerang | Per-contact records ($125+/month) | ❌ No | Unlimited users, but scales with database size [2, 8]. |
| DonorPerfect | Custom quote (likely per-contact/users) | ❌ No | Personalized, includes many features but not flat-rate [7]. |
| Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud | Per-user ($60–$100/month) | ❌ No | Enterprise tiers [4]. |
| Givebutter | Free core (tips on donations) or low-cost | ⚠️ Partial | Unlimited users/contacts on free plan, but transaction-based [4, 9]. |
| Flowlu | Free (2 users), then $9/user/month | ❌ No | Per-user after free tier; nonprofit discounts [2]. |
| DonorDock | Paid tiers (no free plan) | ❌ No | Processing fees; full CRM not free [2]. |
| GivingTech | Free platform + 1.6% avg. transaction fee | ⚠️ Partial | No monthly fee, but fee-based on donations [6]. |
| Donorbox | $0–$150/month + platform fees (1.75–2.95%) | ❌ No | Subscription + fees; full CRM extra [5, 8]. |

- **Why LiveImpact Stands Out**: It's the only one explicitly advertising true flat-rate pricing without per-user or per-record limits, directly addressing growth without cost spikes [1, 3]. Others tie costs to users, contacts, or transactions.

For current pricing or demos, visit [LiveImpact's pricing page](https://www.liveimpact.org/blog/nonprofit-crm-pricing) or contact them, as 2026 details may vary. If you need flat-rate + free options, Givebutter or GivingTech are close alternatives but rely on donation tips/fees.
